Saturday Preview: Hayes stable holds a triple threat in Aurie's Star Handicap

Oh Diamond Lil stamped herself the standout winner of the morning's three Group heats at Randwick, while Sir Delius returned in eye-catching fashion. Gangsta Granny and Ninja both looked sharp while two Gai Waterhouse and Adrian Bott-trained juveniles, Chanterelle and Blessed Eagle, also emerged as horses to follow.

Diamond Necklace stamped herself among Europe's elite fillies with a dominant G1 Nassau Stakes victory on the third day of the Glorious Goodwood Carnival, while Enceladus enhanced his St Leger credentials and Man's Best Friend announced himself as a rising juvenile talent.

The 2024/25 Victorian jockeys' premiership winner Blake Shinn will return to race-riding on Saturday after nine months on the sidelines. As he prepares to reunite with old friend War Machine in the G3 Aurie's Star Stakes, he reflects on how turning rehabilitation into his job got him back on track faster.

On Sunday, professional punter Kingsley Bartholomew broke down how the racing industry is losing the recreational punter, and thus damaging the wagering revenue on which it currently relies. We examine how and whether it is actually feasible to fix that.

The final stakes race of the Australian and New Zealand season has been run, leaving a complete picture of who delivered on the biggest stage. From Autumn Glow's remarkable campaign to the stallions who dominated the Group 1s, juvenile races and broodmare sire ranks, the numbers tell the story of 2025/26.

Bow Echo remains unbeaten with a tough victory in the G1 Sussex Stakes at Goodwood. He had to work for it, in a messy race and was pushed to the line by Gstaad. The Group 3 juvenile event went to Pershaada who will be set for the G1 Nunthorpe Stakes next.

Sequinned headlined the final metropolitan meetings of the current racing season after the well-bred half-sister to Bivouac returned with an impressive first-up victory. Crown Of Fire, Miss Lola and Exceed The Sale also produced eye-catching wins across the country.

Starting on Saturday, Phillip Stokes will be joined by his son Tommy on the trainer's ticket. The well-travelled former soccer star has done the hard yards at home and overseas, and is ready to take the stable to the next level this spring.
